title: LIGHT SEATED INTERVALS
subtitle: SEATED FIRST, THEN STANDING AT THE CHAIR. NO FLOOR TODAY. KIND HIPS.

script.welcome: Good morning Pam. I'm Stratton. Thursday is light seated intervals, about ten minutes. Short little bursts in the chair to wake the body up, a gentle hip stretch, then we stand for a kind hip flexor stretch and a touch of balance at the chair. No floor today. A smaller range is fine on sore-joint days. Well done for showing up.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat, shoulders soft, easy breath.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Settle in. No rush.
script.lastSet: Last one of these. Keep it comfortable.
script.complete: That's us, Pam. Blood moving, shoulders loosened, hips looked after, and a proper little break from the desk. Have a sip of water. Well done.
script.pause: Paused. Take all the time you need.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SEATED MARCH
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of the chair, hands resting on the seat edge or thighs. March gently in place, lifting one knee a few inches, then the other, at an easy steady pace. Swing the arms lightly if you like. Small lifts are plenty. If the front of the left hip pinches, lift the left knee only a little, or just raise the left heel instead. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness.
exercises.speakStart: Seated march. Three little bursts of about twenty seconds. Sit tall, lift one knee a few inches, then the other, easy and steady. Keep the left lift small if the hip grumbles.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Feet flat. Breathe easy.
exercises.speakDone: Seated march done. Lovely, the engine is warm.

exercises.name: SEATED ROW
exercises.cue: Sit tall, feet flat. Reach both arms forward at chest height, empty hands or very light weights. Draw the elbows back close to the ribs and gently squeeze the shoulder blades together, then reach forward again. Smooth, steady rhythm for about twenty seconds. Keep the shoulders down away from the ears. Empty hands are always fine, and a smaller pull is fine on sore-joint days.
exercises.speakStart: Seated row. Two bursts of about twenty seconds. Reach forward, draw the elbows back, gentle squeeze between the shoulder blades. Empty hands are perfect.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Arms down. Shoulders soft.

exercises.name: SEATED OVERHEAD REACH
exercises.cue: Sit tall, feet flat. Start with hands at shoulder height, palms forward, empty or holding very light weights. Press up toward the ceiling as far as is comfortable, then lower back to the shoulders. Easy steady pace for about twenty seconds. No need to lock the elbows or reach all the way up; stop where the shoulders feel happy. Keep the ribs soft and the back tall.
exercises.speakStart: Seated overhead reach. Two bursts of about twenty seconds. Hands at the shoulders, reach up only as high as feels kind, then back down. Empty hands are fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Hands in the lap. Breathe.
exercises.speakDone: Overhead reach done. Well done, Pam.

exercises.name: SEATED FIGURE FOUR (LIGHT)
exercises.cue: Still seated tall, feet flat. Cross the right ankle lightly over the left knee into a gentle figure-four. Do not push the knee down. Stay upright or add the tiniest hinge forward for a mild stretch in the outer hip. Breathe slowly for about twenty seconds, then try the other side if it feels kind. If the front of the left hip pinches, skip that side or skip this one entirely. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness.
exercises.speakStart: Seated figure four, nice and light. About twenty seconds each side. Ankle lightly over the other knee, sit tall, no forcing. Skip it if the front of the hip pinches.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Uncross gently. Feet flat.
exercises.speakDone: Figure four done. Now stand up from the chair nice and slowly, use your hands, take your time.

exercises.name: STANDING HIP FLEXOR
exercises.cue: Stand beside the chair with the right hand lightly on the chair back. Step the left foot back about half a step, not a deep lunge, both feet pointing forward, knees soft. Gently tuck the pelvis under (belt buckle toward the ribs) until you feel a mild stretch at the front of the left hip. A tiny lean is enough. Breathe slowly for about twenty seconds. Small and kind, never aggressive. A lovely undo for all the sitting. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness.
exercises.speakStart: Standing hip flexor, left leg back. Two holds of about twenty seconds. Small step back, pelvis tucked, tiny lean. Kind and small.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Feet together. Easy breath.

exercises.name: CHAIR BALANCE
exercises.cue: Stand behind or beside the sturdy chair with one or both hands on the chair back. Stand tall. Shift your weight onto one foot and lift the other heel, or the whole foot just an inch, for about fifteen seconds. Then switch sides. Eyes on a fixed point ahead, breathe. Hold the chair as firmly as you need. If the left hip grumbles when standing on it, keep the toes of the other foot lightly touching the floor. Stop if anything feels sharp or wobbly in a worrying way.
exercises.speakStart: Chair balance to finish. About fifteen seconds each side. Hands on the chair, stand tall, lift one foot a little, eyes ahead. Hold on as much as you like.
exercises.speakRest: Ten seconds. Both feet down. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Balance done. That's the session, Pam. Warm, loose, and kind to the hips. Have a grand Thursday.
